scheme_name: Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi of Goa
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional village festive theatre group or amateur theatre group
Group must have a tradition of performing plays during village deity festivals for at least 25 years
All roles, including female roles, must be performed by members from the same village; no professional artists are allowed
Performance must be certified by the devasthan or village committee
The group must have a bank account in a Nationalized or Scheduled Bank for payment release
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹20,000 for prose plays or up to ₹30,000 for Sangeet plays (maximum 75% of actual cost), with possible additional support for directors, technical experts, and a scriptwriter stipend.
documents_required: Certificate from the devasthan/traditional village institution/village committee
